$schema_note: Single source for colors, fonts, radii and spacing of the Free My TV home screen (Android HomeView, web/home.css). Units: px at 1920x1080. Values marked source=code mirror what the code has today; changing a token means changing the code it names in the same PR.

rules.contrast: WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for UI text, 3:1 for graphics and large text; brand logotypes are exempt but must stay legible on their tile
rules.focus: visible by scale and brightness, never by color alone

margin_x.source: HomeView.MARGIN (80 of 1920 = 4.2%; with the TV's own overscan it stays inside 5%)

shelf_glow_top.note: white at 8% on the tile's top half (Android tileGlow); web .tile::after 10%

area_share.source: HomeView.crispLogo: logo ink covers ~8.5% of the focused tile

tile_plain.source: HomeView: tile with a logo and no TILE_STYLE

brand.$note: One entry per shelf key. color = HomeApps.SHELF column 4 (no #) and web SAMPLE color. tile = TILE_STYLE / web SHELF gradient [top, bottom]. logo_mode = SHELF column 5. tile_logo_mode = TILE_STYLE third value (0 = logo as lifted, 1 = logo drawn white, 2 = the -dark logo). Existing entries mirror the code; new ones (card 103) carry their evidence.
